_meta.status: frozen for lanes L1/L2/L3 at PR0. A lane adds only the keys it owns, exactly as written here; a deviation needs orchestrator sign-off before the edit.
_meta.source: docs/plans/2026-09-21-setup-three-screen-handoff.md §4/§5/§8, reconciled against the strings already shipped on master 31c4e831b.
rules: PR0 adds no key to ui/src/i18n/*.json. Each lane lands the keys it owns together with the component that references them, because keyCoverage.test.ts reads the literal keys out of the app source.

Every string that interpolates {{count}} ships a complete _one/_other family in BOTH bundles; zh repeats the same value so locale parity stays a plain set equality. This is the rule settings.models already enforces by test (copyAgreement.test.ts) and the class it exists to prevent.
{{names}} is a joined list, so it may never be the subject of a singular verb in English.

Setup says 导入 / import for copying detected API keys into Model Hub. Settings keeps its shipped 迁移 / migrate vocabulary: settings.models is covered by total-scope copy redlines (copyAgreement.test.ts, supplyCopyRedline.test.ts), and renaming it is a separate product-voice decision, not a side effect of this round.
No string in this contract is a credential example. The prototype's sk-demo-example placeholder and its 交互演示，请勿输入真实凭据 / 正在保存模拟配置… lines are preview-only and must not ship (handoff §15).
